leadText: Miraidon (ミライドン Miraidon) is a Legendary Pokémon in the Pokémon Adventures manga.
plainText:
Miraidon (ミライドン Miraidon) is a Legendary Pokémon in the Pokémon Adventures manga.
==History==
===== Background =====
Prior to the events of the manga, and Old Roto witnessed an injured Miraidon crash-landing on a beach near Cabo Poco. When Violet went to check to see if Miraidon was alright, it got up and stole one of his sandwiches. Miraidon took a liking to the boy and began following him around. Later, Violet received a call from Professor Turo, who informed him that Miraidon could regain its lost power if fed the Herba Mystica. At Turo's suggestion, Violet set out to find Turo's son , who had been doing research on the mysterious plants.

===== =====
 sandwich]]
Shortly after setting foot in Uva Academy in Speeding! Paldea's Prince of Speed!!, Violet began looking for Arven's whereabouts. His search led to him crashing the school's opening ceremony and competing in a race against several teachers. All the commotion alerted Arven, who demanded to know how Violet came in contact with Miraidon. Violet ignored the question and instead dragged Arven along to assist in his quest to obtain the Herba Mystica.

In PASV08, at South Province (Area Three), Violet and Arven fought , the Stony Cliff Titan. By using the area's terrain to its advantage, Klawf managed to avoid Violet and Miraidon's pursuit, eventually leaving the latter too exhausted to move. After Klawf was defeated, Arven used the Sweet Herba Mystica it was guarding to make sandwiches for everyone. The herb-filled sandwich successfully powered Miraidon up, giving it the ability to dash, much to Violet's delight.

In PASV10, Arven convinced Violet he needed to train himself to use Miraidon's new speed efficiently so they wouldn't crash into wild Pokémon all the time. While training, Arven received word of a new Titan Pokémon, and the three set out to find it. Upon discovering Titan , they were met with a barrage of boulders raining down the path. Putting their training to the test, Violet and Miraidon successfully reached Bombirdier, allowing the Trainers to battle it. After defeating it, Arven made sandwiches with the Bitter Herba Mystica. The herb-filled sandwich powered Miraidon up once again, giving it the ability to swim.

In PASV14, while trying to raid Team Star's Fire crew, the Schedar Squad, Violet encountered , who wanted to borrow Miraidon to help her find the treasures of ruin. When Violet refused, Scarlet tied him up with her 's thread and stole the Paradox Pokémon. Miraidon, instead of listening to her, raced off towards Arven to eat a sandwich.

In PASV17, Scarlet and Arven sought out and fought , the Lurking Steel Titan. During the battle, it was revealed that Miraidon could sense the Herba Mystica connected to the Titan Pokémon and would pursue them without encouragement. It chased down the elusive Pokémon across East Province (Area Three) until they were able to reconnect with Violet and defeat it. Afterward, Arven made sandwiches with the Salty Herba Mystica. The herb-filled sandwich powered Miraidon up once again, giving it the ability to jump higher. Scarlet, realizing Miraidon wasn't at full strength, returned it to Violet for the time being.

====Personality and characteristics====
 's sandwiches]]
Miraidon has a voracious appetite, which is best shown over its love of sandwiches-specifically ones made by Arven. Its appetite is so strong that it has chowed down on Old Roto multiple times in an attempt to eat one of Arven's meals and ran away from Violet for the potential to enjoy one. After losing its strength, it chose to stay with Violet due to his kindness and willingness to continue feeding it. It is a fast Pokémon perfect for races, a befitting trait alongside Violet's self-proclaimed title as the "Prince of Speed".

Miraidon can sense the Herba Mystica that Titan Pokémon have consumed and will give chase without being ordered to.
